tasks.instruction_text: Hey — I'm looking on Best Friends Animal Society for a young spayed male dog cared for by a private owner within 50 miles of zip 84101. Set the Sex and Sterilization criteria so just that combo shows up.
Reset my last search please — on bestfriends.org I want only spayed female dogs. Both selectors set, not 'Any'. Just spayed females within the Salt Lake City area.

On Best Friends Animal Society, narrow it down to neutered male dogs only — both Sex and Sterilization criteria need to come off 'Any'. I don't want any females mixed in and definitely no intact males.

I'm volunteering this weekend at a fix-and-foster clinic in Salt Lake City, UT, so on bestfriends.org can you filter the adoptable dogs down to males that are still intact (un-neutered)? Both filters need to be set explicitly — don't leave Sex or Sterilization on 'Any'.

OK two-step: first on Best Friends Animal Society set the criteria so we only see spayed female dogs (Sex=Female, Sterilization=Spayed — both explicitly applied, don't leave them on Any). Then tell me how many of the ones still showing are tagged 'Good with kids' and list their names.

Quick reality check — switch the filters over to neutered male dogs on bestfriends.org (both criteria set, not Any), and tell me how many of those are listed as 'Good with kids'. Names plus which one has the highest rating, please. Keep the filter set after.

Apply spayed-female criteria (both selectors must come off Any) on Best Friends Animal Society, then tell me — out of the ones still showing — who's the youngest and how old are they? I'd love to give a young dog a long life with us.
Real quick — before I touch any filter on Best Friends Animal Society, how many adoptable dogs are on the page right now in total? Don't change any selectors, just look.

Btw before I touch anything on bestfriends.org — could you scan the catalog and tell me roughly how many dogs here are still intact (not spayed and not neutered), and how that splits by sex? Don't change the filters, just look.

Without applying any filter yet on Best Friends Animal Society — eyeball the whole catalog and tell me which group is bigger right now: spayed females or neutered males? Give me both counts and the difference.
